data.name: GeminiVideoOmniV2
data.description: Generate a video with audio from a text prompt using Google's Gemini Omni Flash models. Optionally provide reference images and/or videos to guide or edit the result. Describe the desired length (3-10s) directly in the prompt.

input_details.name: model
input_details.tooltip: The Gemini video model used to generate the video.
input_details.hint: Dynamic combo: pick one `options` value for `model`, then send each conditional sub-field below using its full dotted name (prefixed with `model.`, e.g. `model.<sub_field>`). Auto-grow list slots nest one level deeper (e.g. `model.<list>.<slot_1>`). Sending these fields flat (without the prefix) fails with required_input_missing.

input_details.name: model.prompt
input_details.tooltip: Describe the video to generate, or the edit to apply to an attached video. Specify the length directly in the prompt, e.g. "a 6-second clip" or, for the 'extend' task, "extend by 5 seconds"; the generated length may be 3-10 seconds and defaults to 10. The output has audio.

input_details.name: model.aspect_ratio
input_details.tooltip: Output aspect ratio: 16:9 (landscape) or 9:16 (portrait). The 'edit' and 'extend' tasks keep the aspect ratio of the input video instead.

input_details.name: model.task_type
input_details.tooltip: What to do with the prompt and the attached media. With 'auto' the model decides. 'text_to_video' generates from the prompt alone and rejects attached media. 'image_to_video' animates one image, or interpolates from a starting frame to an ending frame when two are attached. 'reference_to_video' treats the attached media as subject references. 'edit' rewrites exactly one attached video, and 'extend' appends new footage to it, so the output starts with the input video.

input_details.name: model.images.image_1
input_details.tooltip: Optional reference image(s) to guide or animate the video. Up to 14 images; with the 'image_to_video' task the first one is the starting frame and an optional second one is the ending frame.

input_details.name: model.videos.video_1
input_details.tooltip: Optional reference video(s) to guide or edit. Up to 3 videos, each up to 10 seconds long.

input_details.name: model.seed
input_details.tooltip: Seed controls whether the node should re-run; results are non-deterministic regardless of seed.

input_details.name: model.temperature
input_details.tooltip: Controls randomness. Lower is more focused/deterministic, higher is more varied.

input_details.name: model.top_p
input_details.tooltip: Nucleus sampling: sample from the smallest token set whose cumulative probability reaches top_p.
